blocks.arabic_text: يَوْمَئِذٍ تُعْرَضُوْنَ لَا تَخْفٰى مِنْكُمْ خَافِيَةٌ
blocks.text: On that day, you will all be presented and nothing (no action or word) of yours shall remain hidden.[^1]

Hadhrat Anas (RA) reports, "I was one day with Hadhrat Umar bin Khattaab (RA) when he went into an orchard. There was a wall between us and he was standing in the middle of the orchard when I heard him say (to himself), 'O Ameerul Mu'mineen! By Allaah! You should fear Allaah or He will definitely punish you."[^2]
Remaining silent and Guarding the Tongue
The Silence of our Guide Rasulullaah ﷺ

In a lengthy narration, Hadhrat Simaak says that he once asked Hadhrat Jaabir bin Samurah (RA), "Did you associate often with Nabi ﷺ?" Hadhrat Jaabir (RA) replied, "Yes. He was a person who often remained silent."[^3]

Hadhrat Abu Maalik Ashja'ee (RA) reports that his father said, "We were little boys when we used to sit in the company of Rasulullaah ﷺ and have never seen anyone remain silent as much as Rasulullaah ﷺ did. Whenever his companions would talk too much, he merely smiled."[^4]

Hadhrat Ubaadah bin Saamit (RA) narrates that Rasulullaah ﷺ was once out with his companions. As he rode, one of them stepped out ahead of him. Hadhrat Mu'aadh bin Jabal (RA) said, "O Rasulullaah ﷺ! I pray that Allaah takes our lives before yours. May Allaah never show us the day (of your demise), but should we see it, what deeds should we carry out after you? May my parents be sacrificed for you, O Rasulullaah ﷺ! Should it be Jihaad in the path of Allaah?" Rasulullaah ﷺ replied, "Jihaad in the path of Allaah is an excellent deed, but people have become accustomed to it. (What you should be doing is) Something that exercises greater restraint (on the carnal self)." "Then fasting and Sadaqah?" Hadhrat Mu'aadh (RA) asked. "Fasting and Sadaqah are an excellent deeds," Rasulullaah ﷺ commented, "but people have become accustomed to it. (What you should be doing is) Something that exercises greater restraint (on the carnal self)."
Hadhrat Mu'aadh (RA) then went on to mention every type of good deed, but each time Rasulullaah ﷺ's reply was, "But people have become accustomed to it.
